note: gen-2 baseline: grew data/videos.csv 801 -> 2413 rows (broadened SEED_WORDS across ~50 topic categories via api_scrape.py) and added a 'category' feature (OneHotEncoder, see features.py). Re-froze benchmark/dataset.csv (1671/366/376 train/val/test). New epoch - not comparable to gen-1's log_mse=2.776. val/test metrics closely agree (log_r2 0.567 val / 0.559 test, mdape 65.3% val / 69.0% test), a large jump over gen-1 (log_r2 0.213, mdape 89.7%) plausibly from both the ~5x bigger val/test sets being far less noisy and the new category signal. Not yet beaten by any hypothesis within this epoch.
